post.news: Marketing explained with Bollywood songs. Retargeting ads:
post.take: Tujhe Dekha Toh Yeh Jaana Sanam. You looked once, now it follows you everywhere.
post.caption: Looked at a lamp once. Now it's on Instagram, YouTube and every website you open. 💡 That's retargeting: ads that follow people who already showed interest. Creepy or smart? 👇
post.first_comment: That one sofa has been following me since 2023.
